inShort: A and B volley back and forth while shuffling together along the kitchen line, to the far sideline and back.
rules: A and B start straight across at the kitchen line, both at the same sideline.
Volley back and forth while you both shuffle sideways along the line. To the far sideline and back is one round.
On the way out, one of you hits only backhands, the other only forehands. On the way back it flips.
Stay in an open stance: feet never square to the net, so you can still reach both sides.
A ball may bounce once and you keep going.
Go for 2 rounds in a row. A miss sends both of you back to zero.
tooEasy: No bounce allowed. Even harder: raise the pace, or widen the zone you shuffle along.
tooHard: Shuffle slowly and go for one round only.
goodLooksLike: The paddles stay in front of the body while moving, and the rally survives the turn at the sideline.
